info.brief: Provides functionality to get the advertising id and tracking status. Supported on iOS and Android. [icon:ios] [icon:android]
info.description: Provides functionality to get the advertising id and tracking status. Supported on iOS and Android. [icon:ios] [icon:android]

elements.name: adinfo.get
elements.description: Get a table with advertising information. [icon:attention] function returns nil if values do not ready
elements.examples:
function init(self)
    adinfo.get(function(self, info)
      print(info.ad_ident, info.ad_tracking_enabled)
    end)
end
